name: OrokuBlocks for Elementor
author: orokublocks

sections.description:
OrokuBlocks for Elementor powers up your theme with the best widgets to enhance Elementor, including 13 free widgets and 40+ total in the pro version. Browse between lots of categories, components & presets carefully crafted to easily add to your website in just a few seconds!

Useful Links

  • Demo
  • Documentation
  • Support Policy
  • Go Pro

Main Features

Stand Out With 40+ Dedicated Designs!

We focused our widget designs on creative and innovative ideas, no simple widgets like menus, tables or text boxes. Scoring, testimonial, item review, referral boxes and more. Also, in the Pro version, you’ll find that we included all the widgets Figma files!

Powered by the Very Best Plugins!

Starting with base widgets for Elementor, we also power widgets with highly rated plugins, like SportsPress, for providing info and stats to player cards, or GamiPress, integrating it for achievement, points and rank boxes!

Really Easy to Use & Customize!

Using Elementor as a base for the plugin allows you to manage them as any other Elementor widget you’ve worked with before! And for beginners, it’s really easy, just drag and drop the one you like and start customizing the options to achieve what you need for your website!

Widgets 40+ (13 Free)

General

Here you will find all the widgets that don’t need any other additional plugins, besides Elementor. From scoring rating boxes, perfect for movies and gaming reviews, to testimonial boxes, great for highlighting affilliate products.

GamiPress

Use these widgets to easily showcase all your GamiPress achievements, points and ranks in a nice and elegant way. These are perfect for adding a great gamification element to your website or community!

SportsPress

Use these widgets to easily showcase all your SportsPress information, things like player name and position, team logo and name, player photo and metrics, and much more!

WooCommerce

Easily create widgets to display all your WooCommerce item details in an elegant fashion. With just a few clicks, grab all the product information, rating, category, name, price, variables and more!

Feedback

We care a lot about your opinion!, please let us know what you think of the widgets and what would you like to see added in the future!.

Reviews

Being a new plugin, we would really appreciate it if you could leave a review. If you like the plugin, help us by leaving a 5* rating. This will allow us to reach more people and keep working on improving the plugin and adding more and more widgets! Thanks a lot!
sections.installation:
To install the plugin, go to your WordPress dashboard and follow these steps:

  • Go to Plugins > Add Plugin
  • Click on the Upload Plugin button at the top left side of the page
  • Click Browse…, go to the folder where you have the plugin .zip file stored and select it
  • Click on Install Now to install it
  • After it installs, click on the Activate Plugin button to finish

We highly recommend following our documentation more detailed installation and setup instructions.
sections.faq:
What do i need to be able to use the plugin?

The plugin requires a WordPress installation and the Elementor plugin to be installed and active. Each widget may require additional plugins to be installed, please check the respective widget documentation for a full list of requirements.

The widget is not displaying on the page

Please make sure that you haven’t disabled the widget from the plugin options, take a look at how the plugin Widget page works in our documentation for more details.

The widget is missing some information

Some widgets take the information they display from other plugins, so you need to make sure that you have entered the necessary information via the respective plugin dashboard interface. For example, the Achivevement widget requires the GamiPress plugin and an achievement to have been previously created to be able to display its information. Please check the respective widget documentation for a full list of requirements.

I need help installing the plugin

Please follow our documentation install and setup guide for a detailed step by step guide on how to install the plugin.

I need help with a widget

We have a documentation page available for each widget the plugin includes, please open our documentation and search for the specific widget you need help with from the left sidebar menu.
